## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Aug 5, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Gianna Alarid_, Aug 5, 2026, 1/5: "I wouldnt download this. genuinely ruined this app, it used to be good, it was easily a 5 stars, but now its basically unusable. there is a 700 message limit for a whole day, but they also make you watch ads every 3 messages? sometimes less, why can't you just do one or the other? your already showing 90 ads in the span on 10 minutes, bring the unlimited chats back. not to mention there are ALREADY ads on the top of the screen, when you first open the app, before an an ad, and at the bottom."
            2. _April H_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "as long as you can afford the subscription the app is good. if you can't then the ads get aggravating especially being at the top of chat. it makes it to where you can not see what you type after a few lines. here lately, I can chat for a few paragraphs then it stop responding. have to close app and restart it. a few more paragraphs then it quits responding. have to close and restart again. very annoying. if they would get rid of ads at the top of messages then it would be ok. need to fix bugs."
            3. _LilyCat382_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "Chai used to be a daily break. You could just chat, make stories and be creative. Today, bugs, arbitrary message limits and constant subscription notices dominate the app. Sometimes you have hundreds of messages, then suddenly 0 with no explanation. It's sad to see how an app with so much potential and a loyal community has lost so much quality. I don't want to use the app anymore, it's no use, you can't chat anymore. Please bring back the old Chai."
<!--/ir-theme-->
